title: Aamir Khan Receives Alleged Death Threat From Lawrence Bishnoi Gang After Third Marriage
excerpt: Mumbai Police are investigating a social media post and voice note threatening the Bollywood actor over his July 5 wedding to Gauri Spratt, as the Bishnoi gang targets yet another film industry figure.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Aamir Khan received a death threat linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang after his third marriage.
  • The threat accuses Khan of promoting 'love jihad' through his marriage to Gauri Spratt.
  • Mumbai Police are investigating the authenticity of the threat; no formal complaint has been filed.
  • The Bishnoi gang has a history of targeting Bollywood celebrities, including Salman Khan.
  • Aamir Khan has received an alleged death threat from associates of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, communicated via a social media post and voice note now under police investigation.
  • The threat accuses the actor of promoting "love jihad" following his July 5, 2026 marriage to Gauri Spratt, his third wedding.
  • Mumbai Police and the Cyber Cell are verifying the authenticity of the claims; no formal complaint has been filed by Khan or his team.

The Threat

Bollywood actor Aamir Khan is the latest Indian film industry figure to be targeted by the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, according to multiple reports. A social media post and an accompanying voice note, both attributed to associates of the incarcerated gangster Lawrence Bishnoi, surfaced online threatening the 61-year-old actor over his recent marriage.

https://x.com/DeccanHerald/status/2078438861630308613

The alleged threat was issued by individuals identified as Arzoo Bishnoi — described as Lawrence Bishnoi's brother — and another person identified as Tyson Bishnoi. In the post, Khan was accused of promoting "love jihad" through his third marriage, to British national Gauri Spratt, which took place in an intimate ceremony on July 5, 2026.

> **"Actor Salman Khan has been the gang's most prominent target, with the feud dating back to a 1998 blackbuck hunting case."**

"Actor Salman Khan has been the gang's most prominent target, with the feud dating back to a 1998 blackbuck hunting case."

"People like Aamir Khan are promoting what is being called 'Love Jihad' in our country, which is against our culture. We will not tolerate this man, and he will soon be made to face the consequences."

— Post attributed to Arzoo Bishnoi and Tyson Bishnoi

The post continued: "We promise our brothers, sisters, and fellow citizens that whoever promotes such disgraceful acts will be dealt with in our own way. Those who are encouraging this in the name of stardom will be silenced."

Police Investigation Underway

Mumbai Police and the Cyber Cell have initiated an investigation after receiving information about the threat via Facebook, according to Zoom TV. Authorities are working to verify whether the social media accounts involved are legitimate and whether they can be definitively linked to the Bishnoi gang.

As of now, neither Aamir Khan nor his team have filed an official complaint with the Mumbai Police, and the actor has not issued any public statement regarding the threats. The authenticity of both the post and the alleged audio clip remains unverified, according to reports.

A Pattern of Celebrity Threats

The alleged threat against Khan fits a pattern of the Bishnoi gang targeting Bollywood celebrities. Actor Salman Khan has been the gang's most prominent target, with the feud dating back to a 1998 blackbuck hunting case. In April 2024, two men on a motorcycle fired shots outside Salman Khan's Galaxy Apartments residence in Mumbai's Bandra suburb. Lawrence Bishnoi claimed responsibility for the attack on social media.

Other Bollywood figures who have reportedly received threats from the gang include actors Ranveer Singh and Kapil Sharma, and filmmaker Rohit Shetty. The Mumbai Police have filed multiple cases in connection with these incidents and have invoked the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act in the Salman Khan case.

Khan's Personal Life in the Spotlight

Aamir Khan married Gauri Spratt on July 5, 2026, in an intimate ceremony. It is his third marriage — he was previously married to Reena Dutta (1986–2002) and filmmaker Kiran Rao (2005–2021). The wedding drew widespread attention and, evidently, hostility from certain quarters.

The threat underscores the persistent security challenges facing India's entertainment industry, particularly from organized crime networks that have historically sought to exert influence over Bollywood. For the Indian diaspora, who follow Bollywood closely, the incident is a reminder that the industry's biggest names continue to navigate threats that extend well beyond box-office competition.

What Happens Next

The Mumbai Police investigation will focus on verifying the identities behind the social media post and voice note, and determining whether they have genuine ties to the Bishnoi gang or are an attempt to use the group's name for intimidation. If the threats are confirmed as credible, Khan's security detail is likely to be upgraded, following the precedent set in the Salman Khan case, where the actor now moves under heavy police protection.
